designationHistory.name: Lake George Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the refuge as the Lake George Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8153.
designationHistory.note: North Dakota (Kidder County area per FWS CCP). Renamed by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
